title: The Judgment on Edom and the Seir Mountains
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel with a prophecy against Mount Seir and Edom. Because of their eternal hostility toward Israel, for handing over the Israelites to the sword in times of disaster, and for their boastful claims to take possession of the land of Israel and Judah, the Lord announces judgment. The land shall become an everlasting desolation; its cities will lie in ruins, the mountains filled with the slain, and no one shall dwell there anymore. Just as Edom rejoiced over Israel's destruction, so it too shall be laid waste, that they may know that I am the Lord.
